# Policy schema

A policy object is a YAML document with these fields.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | string | yes | `sluice.bino.bi/v1alpha1`, `sluice.bino.bi/v1beta1`. See [Kinds](#kinds). |
| `kind` | string | yes | See [Kinds](#kinds). |
| `metadata.name` | string | yes | Lower-case letters, digits and `-`. Starts and ends with a letter or digit. Unique per kind. |
| `metadata.labels` | map |  | Free keys and values. Sluice ignores them. |
| `metadata.annotations` | map |  | Free keys and values. Sluice ignores them. |
| `metadata.priority` | int |  | 0 to 1000. Higher comes first. |
| `spec` | object | yes | The fields of the kind. |

## Shared fields

These kinds have the fields below: `SqlAccessPolicy`, `RowFilterPolicy`, `ColumnMaskPolicy`, `QueryRejectPolicy`, `QueryRewritePolicy`, `ApprovalPolicy`, `RelationshipPolicy`.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enforcementMode` | string |  | `Enforce`, `Audit`, `DryRun`. Default `Enforce`. The others do not apply the policy. |
| `match` | [Selector](#selector) | yes | What the policy covers. Needs `any` or `all`. |
| `exclude` | [Selector](#selector) |  | What the policy leaves out. |
| `conditions` | [Condition](#condition) list |  | All must be true. Not in `RelationshipPolicy`. |

## Types

### Selector

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `any` | [Clause](#clause) list |  | One clause must match. |
| `all` | [Clause](#clause) list |  | Every clause must match. |

### Clause

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subjects.jwtClaims[].claim` | string | yes | Claim path. Dots separate the parts. |
| `subjects.jwtClaims[].op` | string | yes | `Equals`, `NotEquals`, `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists`, `Matches`. |
| `subjects.jwtClaims[].value` | any |  | For `Equals`, `NotEquals`. |
| `subjects.jwtClaims[].values` | []any |  | For `In`, `NotIn`. |
| `subjects.jwtClaims[].pattern` | string |  | Regular expression for `Matches`. |
| `subjects.groups` | []string |  | Group names. One is enough. |
| `subjects.apiKeys` | []string |  | Subject ids of API key subjects. |
| `subjects.ipRanges` | []string |  | CIDR ranges. The address of the client must be in one. |
| `subjects.roles` | []string |  | Values of the `roles` claim. Without the claim, Sluice uses the groups. |
| `resources` | [ResourceSelector](#resourceselector) |  | Tables to match. |

### ResourceSelector

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `catalogs` | []string |  | Catalog names. `*` is a wildcard. |
| `schemas` | []string |  | Schema names. |
| `tables` | []string |  | Table names. |
| `columns` | []string |  | Column names. A mask needs them. |
| `tags` | []string |  | Tags of a `DataClassification`. |
| `actions` | []string |  | `SELECT`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`. |

### Condition

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name of the check. |
| `expression` | string | yes | CEL. Must give true or false. |

### Predicate

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | [Predicate](#predicate) list |  | Every part must hold. |
| `any` | [Predicate](#predicate) list |  | One part must hold. |
| `not` | [Predicate](#predicate) |  | The part must not hold. |
| `column` | string |  | Column to test. |
| `op` | string |  | `Equals`, `NotEquals`, `In`, `NotIn`, `GreaterThan`, `GreaterThanOrEqual`, `LessThan`, `LessThanOrEqual`, `Between`, `Like`, `NotLike`, `IsNull`, `IsNotNull`, `Matches`, `StartsWith`, `EndsWith`, `Contains`. |
| `value` | any |  | Value to compare with. |
| `values` | []any |  | For `In`, `NotIn`, `Between`. |

### SyntheticPrivacy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minGroupSize` | int |  | Smallest group of source rows a value, bin or bound may come from. 2 or more. Default 5. |
| `clipOutliers.lower` | float |  | Source quantile of the lower bound. 0 or more, below `upper`. |
| `clipOutliers.upper` | float |  | Source quantile of the upper bound. At most 1. |
| `extremeJitter` | object |  | Moves the lower and upper bound by a random share of the range. `off` turns it off. |
| `extremeJitter.min` | float |  | Smallest share. 0 or more. |
| `extremeJitter.max` | float |  | Largest share. At most 0.5. |
| `spikeWarning` | bool |  | Warn about a few rows far from the rest. Default true. |
| `strictTags` | []string |  | Tags whose columns need a generator set by a column entry or a rule. Default `pii`. Only on the data source. |
| `rejectExactMatches` | []string |  | Columns that together must not equal a source row. Only on a table. |
| `noise` | object |  | Adds Laplace noise to the profile counts. Only on the data source. |
| `noise.epsilon` | float |  | Privacy budget of one build of the whole data source. From 0.001 to 100. Smaller is more private and less exact. |
| `bounds` | object |  | Public range of a number, time or date column. Only on a column entry, with `noise`. |
| `bounds.min` | any |  | Lower end: a number (seconds of the day for `TIME`), or an ISO date or timestamp for `DATE` and `TIMESTAMP`. Same kind as `max`. |
| `bounds.max` | any |  | Upper end, above `min`. |

### SyntheticRule

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `match.columns` | []string |  | Column name patterns. `*` is a wildcard. Case does not matter. |
| `match.types` | []string |  | Column type patterns, for example `DECIMAL*`. Case does not matter. |
| `match.tags` | []string |  | Tags of a `DataClassification`. |
| `generator` | string | yes | Generator name, for example `distribution`, `categorical` or `randomString`. See [Generators](../operations/synthetic-data.md#generators). |
| `args` | map |  | Arguments of the generator. |

## SqlAccessPolicy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | string | yes | `allow`, `deny`. |
| `message` | string |  | Message of a deny. |
| `errorCode` | string |  | Code of a deny. Default `ACL_DENIED`. |

## RowFilterPolicy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter.predicate` | [Predicate](#predicate) | one of two | Filter as a tree. |
| `filter.expression` | string | one of two | Filter in CEL. |
| `combine` | string |  | `restrictive`, `permissive`. Default `restrictive`: all filters must hold. |

## ColumnMaskPolicy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mask.type` | string | yes | `null`, `constant`, `partial`, `hash`, `regex`, `truncate`, `jitter`, `fpe`, `fake`. |
| `mask.args.value` | any |  | `constant`: the new value. |
| `mask.args.showFirst` | int |  | `partial`: characters kept at the start. |
| `mask.args.showLast` | int |  | `partial`: characters kept at the end. |
| `mask.args.maskChar` | string |  | `partial`: replacement character. Default `*`. |
| `mask.args.algorithm` | string |  | `hash`: `sha256`, `hmac_sha256`. Default `sha256`. |
| `mask.args.saltRef` | string |  | `hash`: secret reference to the salt. |
| `mask.args.pattern` | string |  | `regex`: pattern to replace. |
| `mask.args.replacement` | string |  | `regex`: new text. |
| `mask.args.length` | int |  | `truncate`: characters kept. |
| `mask.args.suffix` | string |  | `truncate`: text added at the end. |
| `mask.args.range` | float |  | `jitter`: largest change. Above 0, below 1. |
| `mask.args.seed` | string |  | `jitter`, `fake`: seed. Plain text or a secret reference. |
| `mask.args.keyRef` | string |  | `fpe`: secret reference to the key. |
| `mask.args.tweak` | string |  | `fpe`: tweak in hex. |
| `mask.args.alphabet` | string |  | `fpe`: `numeric` (default), `lower` or `alphanumeric`. |
| `mask.args.customAlphabet` | string |  | `fpe`: own alphabet. |
| `mask.args.fakeType` | string |  | `fake`: `name`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `phone`, `company`, `city`, `country` or `uuid`. |

## QueryRejectPolicy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reject.rules` | list | yes | At least one rule. |
| `reject.rules[].name` | string |  | Rule name. |
| `reject.rules[].expression` | string |  | CEL. Empty means always reject. |
| `reject.rules[].message` | string |  | Message for the client. |
| `reject.rules[].code` | string |  | Error code. Default `ACL_REJECTED`. |

## QueryRewritePolicy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rewrite` | object | yes | At least one of the fields below. |
| `rewrite.limit.max` | int |  | Maximum rows. 1 to 2147483647. |
| `rewrite.sample.rate` | float |  | Share of rows. Above 0, at most 1. |
| `rewrite.sample.method` | string |  | `reservoir`, `bernoulli`, `system`. Default `reservoir`. |
| `rewrite.timeout` | duration |  | Query timeout. |

## ApprovalPolicy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `when.columnsAccessed` | []string |  | Column patterns. Use of one needs approval. |
| `when.predicates[].column` | string | yes | Column pattern in a comparison. |
| `when.predicates[].op` | string |  | `=`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `like`, `ilike`, `in` or `isnull`. Empty means any. |
| `when.predicates[].value` | string |  | Compared value. Empty means any. |
| `reason` | string |  | Text for the approver. |

## DataSource

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes | `postgres`, `mysql`, `sqlite`, `s3`, `http`, `duckdb_file`, `motherduck`, `synthetic`. |
| `connection` | string | for `postgres`, `mysql` | Connection URL. |
| `credentialsRef` | string |  | Secret reference. `postgres`, `mysql`: the password. `s3`: the access key as JSON. |
| `path` | string | for `sqlite`, `duckdb_file` | Database file. |
| `bucket` | string | for `s3` | Bucket name. |
| `region` | string | for `s3` | Region. |
| `allowedPaths` | []string |  | `s3`: files to read. One view per file. |
| `endpoint` | string |  | `s3`: host of an S3-compatible store. |
| `urls` | []string | for `http` | File URLs. One view per file. |
| `headersRef` | string |  | `http`: secret reference to a JSON object of headers. |
| `format` | string |  | `s3`, `http`: `parquet`, `csv`, `json`, `xlsx`. Default: the file extension. |
| `database` | string | for `motherduck` | Database name. |
| `tokenRef` | string | for `motherduck` | Secret reference to the token. |
| `synthetic` | object | for `synthetic` | Builds a snapshot of generated rows from the profile of another data source. The name has only lower-case letters and digits. See [Synthetic data](../operations/synthetic-data.md). |
| `synthetic.source` | string | yes | Name of the data source to profile. Not a `synthetic` one. |
| `synthetic.seed` | string | yes | Secret reference to the seed. At least 16 bytes. The same seed and data give the same rows. |
| `synthetic.build.onStart` | string |  | `never`, `ifMissing`. Default `never`. `ifMissing` builds at server start when no snapshot exists. |
| `synthetic.privacy` | [SyntheticPrivacy](#syntheticprivacy) |  | Privacy settings for all tables. |
| `synthetic.rules` | [SyntheticRule](#syntheticrule) list |  | Generator rules for all tables. A table rule comes first. |
| `synthetic.tables` | list | yes | At least one table. |
| `synthetic.tables[].name` | string | yes | Source table as `schema.table`. |
| `synthetic.tables[].size.ratio` | float | one of two | Share of the source rows. Above 0, at most 1. A build over `synthetic.maxRatio` of the server config fails. |
| `synthetic.tables[].size.rows` | int | one of two | Fixed row count. 0 copies only the columns. |
| `synthetic.tables[].privacy` | [SyntheticPrivacy](#syntheticprivacy) |  | Privacy settings for this table. Not `strictTags` or `noise`. `bounds` only on a column entry. |
| `synthetic.tables[].columns` | map |  | Generator per column name. Each entry has `generator`, `args` and `privacy`, as in a rule. `privacy` has no `strictTags` or `noise`. See [Generators](../operations/synthetic-data.md#generators). |
| `synthetic.tables[].rules` | [SyntheticRule](#syntheticrule) list |  | Generator rules for this table. A column entry comes first. |

## SubjectBinding

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issuer` | string |  | Issuer (`iss`) of the JWTs. |
| `audience` | string |  | Expected audience (`aud`). |
| `jwksUrl` | string |  | URL of the signing keys. Needs `issuer` and `audience`. |
| `hmacSecretRef` | string |  | Secret reference to the HMAC key. |
| `jwksCacheTtl` | duration |  | Cache time of the signing keys. Default `10m`. |
| `clockSkew` | duration |  | Allowed clock difference. Default `60s`. |
| `claims.subjectId` | string |  | JWT: claim path, default `sub`. API key: the subject id. |
| `claims.email` | string |  | JWT: claim path. API key: the email. |
| `claims.groups` | string |  | JWT: claim path. API key: one group. |
| `claims.tenantId` | string |  | JWT: path to the value. API key: the value. Policies read it as the `tenantId` claim. |
| `claims.allowedRegions` | string |  | JWT: path to the value. API key: the value. Policies read it as the `allowedRegions` claim. |
| `rateLimit.rps` | float |  | Requests per second for each subject. |
| `rateLimit.burst` | int |  | Burst. Default 1. |
| `budget.cpuSecondsPerDay` | int |  | Query seconds per subject and UTC day. |
| `budget.rowsPerDay` | int |  | Rows per subject and UTC day. |
| `apiKeys[].id` | string | yes | Key id. |
| `apiKeys[].hashRef` | string | yes | Secret reference to the key hash. |
| `apiKeys[].groups` | []string |  | Groups of the subject. |

## DataClassification

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rules` | list | yes | At least one rule. |
| `rules[].resources` | [ResourceSelector](#resourceselector) |  | Tables and columns. No `tags`, no `actions`. Without it, the rule tags every table. |
| `rules[].tags` | []string | yes | Tags to set. Lower-case letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`. |

## RelationshipPolicy

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend.endpoint` | string | yes | URL of the OpenFGA API. |
| `backend.storeId` | string | yes | OpenFGA store id. |
| `backend.authorizationModelId` | string |  | OpenFGA model id. |
| `backend.tokenRef` | string |  | Secret reference to the bearer token. |
| `backend.timeout` | duration |  | Timeout of a check. Default `3s`. |
| `checks` | list | yes | At least one check. |
| `checks[].objectTemplate` | string | yes | Object to check, for example `table:{{table}}`. |
| `checks[].relation` | string | yes | Relation the subject needs. |
| `checks[].subjectTemplate` | string |  | Default `user:{{subject.id}}`. |
